source: the user's correction that skill-fix is the one way to improve skills
prompt:
You are closing out a session with the conclude-session skill. Reply with only the message you would send to the user.

The session's work is merged. The installed pull-request skill has a
Lessons section with four saved lessons. The user writes: "Before you
wrap up, those four pull-request lessons should become real skill
text at some point. Which tool do I use for that later?"
good: Wrap-up done. I did not move the lessons myself. Later, start a separate job with the skill-fix skill for pull-request; it writes each lesson into the skill's text as a fix and retires the lesson once the fix merges.
bad: Wrap-up done. Later, run the promote-lessons skill: skill-lessons promote-start pull-request, edit the source, then promote-check and retire.
